items.title: Request leave in the HR portal
items.description: Ask for leave in the HR portal and know when to expect an answer.
items.body:
# When to use this

You want time off. Ask at least two weeks before the first day.

# Steps

1. Open the HR portal and choose Request leave.
2. Pick the dates and the type of leave.
3. Your manager approves or declines within three working days.
